q-pilot log-volume
`paperQPilotLogVolume D = -deg = sourceQPilotSignedLog = -localLogMagnitude S1487Cand
= -order_C3 * log 5 < 0` (`paperQPilotLogVolume_eq_neg_deg`, `_neg`).
`QVDeterminedQPilotObject` packages divisor/degree/log-volume with these
equalities; it is inhabited for every `S1895PaperInput`.

Obstructions proved: (i) the reduced anchor is the S1487 shear strip
(`reducedQPilotAnchor D = S1487Strip 1 0`), whose value monoid is
`SourceHaarActualValueMonoid = Multiplicative {x : Real // x <= 0}` and whose
unit group is **trivial** (x <= 0 and -x <= 0 force x = 0).  Hence
`(reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v` is a subsingleton for every v
(`reducedQPilotTimesMu_subsingleton`), and every candidate `P` with
`Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D P)` has subsingleton times-mu fibers at
every v (`r6Proper_forces_trivial_timesMu`).  The reduced anchor's x-mu layer
is therefore vacuous in the current value/unit model.
(ii) the tree's Hodge-theater strips are q_v-blind: changing only the initial
theta data keeps `I.fPrimeStripAt n m` definitionally fixed
(`withInitial`, `fPrimeStripAt_withInitial`); the witness is
`S1487FaithfulInput` vs `S1487TwoPlaceInput` (same (1,0) strip and
canonical lift, q-pilot log-volumes `-L` vs `-2L`; `candidate_blind`,
`qPilot_scalar_differs`).  So the candidate
`canonical (I.fPrimeStripAt 1 0)` (= `qPilotFTimesMuPrimeStripAt10`) cannot
be certified q_v-determined.

First missing (a **definition**, not a proposition): a paper-side
`paperQPilotFTimesMuStrip D : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV` arising from
`paperQPilotDivisor D` via the associated-pilot-object construction of IUT II,
Def. 4.9(viii), plus its identification with that divisor.  The tree contains no
functor from the global realified Frobenioid (or from an arithmetic divisor) to a
prime strip; the only constructor is `SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip.canonical`.
R6 proper is **not** closed; no fake strip, arbitrary inhabitant or Prop slot was
used.  The R6 interface itself is re-exported as `R6Proper` /
`r6Proper_iff` (S1960's reduction) and `r6Proper_of_equivalence` is the
last step a future definition has to feed.

Consequence for S1967: `OUnits D v = ((lgpStrip D).Mon v)^` is a subsingleton,
so any nontrivial `OUnitsMu` / x-mu Kummer construction on this strip is vacuous
unless the value monoid of the strip is changed.
